## Important context

- Website inquiries are invitations to discuss a property or business need. They are not offers, contracts, appraisals, legal advice, financing commitments, securities offerings, or promises of returns.
- Calculator and demo outputs are scenarios based on inputs and assumptions. Material values, records, financing, expenses, and transaction terms require independent verification.
- Seller-financing and Subject-To discussions involve material legal, lending, tax, insurance, and financial considerations. Visitors are encouraged to obtain qualified independent advice.
- Private company workspace routes, APIs, and customer or lead records are not public sources and must not be indexed, summarized, or cited.
